title: Sable and the Promise
author: Lior Crane
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
